definitions.explanation: A large North American bird raised for its meat. In Japan it is known mostly as the roast served at Christmas and at American Thanksgiving.

examples.japanese: {七面鳥|しちめんちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丸焼|まるや}き→丸焼き：21373_maruyaki⟧にした。
⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{感謝祭|かんしゃさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{七面鳥|しちめんちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: In America, people eat turkey at Thanksgiving.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦クリスマス→クリスマス：03839_kurisumasu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{七面鳥|しちめんちょう}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧フライド⟦チキン→チキン：11029_chikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: At Christmas in Japan, more families eat fried chicken than turkey.

notes:
The name means "seven-faced bird": the bare skin of the male's head and neck changes color, between red, blue and white.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {七面鳥|しちめんちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{丸焼|まるや}き→丸焼き：21373_maruyaki⟧: roast turkey
- {七面鳥|しちめんちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧: turkey meat

WATCH OUT:
ターキー is also used, especially on menus and for the meat, and is the word for a turkey in bowling (three strikes in a row). The country Turkey is トルコ, never {七面鳥|しちめんちょう}.
